description: FINDING, 20k - the mirror of `not run yet`. A node has no published record until the cycle it belongs to ENDS, so during a run every phase ahead of the front says the same words as a phase nothing has ever measured. On 2026-08-09 that was watched on prod: the map read `not run yet` while a promotion was running towards it, which is indistinguishable from the environment never having been built. The two are not the same claim and must not share a sentence. The contrast case below is the same node with nothing running, which must still say `not run yet` - a word that means `nothing recorded` has to keep meaning it.

expect.note: a cycle is under way and has not got here
its step is in Actions, not in a timeline
